import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """district,fire_days,per_1000_km2
Indragiri Hilir,12821,950.04
Indragiri Hulu,8720.5,1084.6
Kampar,3296.3,305.83
Kuantan Singingi,1762.4,331.96
Pelalawan,19904,1516.4
Rokan Hilir,12801,1388.7
Rokan Hulu,2415.1,332
Bengkalis,14163,1657.1
Kepulauan Meranti,5525.2,1510.7
Kota Dumai,5261.9,2307
Kota Pekanbaru,139.14,221.26
Siak,8849,1126.4
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_districts(df):
    """Two rankings: raw totals and density. They do not agree."""
    df = df.sort_values("per_1000_km2")
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(9, 3.6), sharey=True)
    axes[0].barh(df["district"], df["fire_days"], color="#cc4c02")
    axes[0].set_xlabel("Fire detection days, 2015 to 2024")
    axes[1].barh(df["district"], df["per_1000_km2"], color="#662506")
    axes[1].set_xlabel("Per 1,000 km²")
    fig.suptitle("Riau districts: total against density", x=0.02, ha="left")
    fig.tight_layout()
    return fig

plot_districts(df)
plt.show()

import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """fire_days,year
19661,2015
9112,2016
4224.7,2017
9585,2018
28577,2019
6354.1,2020
5380.1,2021
2677.7,2022
5051.3,2023
4570.9,2024
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_years(df):
    """The province, one bar per year."""
    df = df.sort_values("year")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3))
    ax.bar(df["year"].astype(int).astype(str), df["fire_days"], color="#cc4c02")
    ax.set_ylabel("Fire detection days")
    ax.set_title("Riau, fire detection days per year", loc="left")
    return fig

plot_years(df)
plt.show()
